    // Dispatches an event to the regions of `PAR` (in region order). The event goes to `PAR`
    // and its ancestors only if no region consumed it. Stops early if a region's transition left `PAR`.
    private void par_dispatch_regions(EventId event_id)
    {
        bool consumed = false;
        this.par_exited = false;
        
        if (this.par_region_1_dispatch(event_id))
        {
            consumed = true;
        }
        if (this.par_exited)
        {
            return;
        }
        
        if (this.par_region_2_dispatch(event_id))
        {
            consumed = true;
        }
        if (this.par_exited)
        {
            return;
        }
        
        this.region_event_unhandled = false;
        if (consumed)
        {
            return;
        }
        
        // No region consumed the event: `PAR` and its ancestors get it.
        switch (event_id)
        {
            case EventId.EV2: this.par_ev2(); break;
            case EventId.DO: this.par_do(); break;
            case EventId.RESET: this.par_reset(); break;
        }
    }
    
    // Dispatches an event to the regions of `A3` (in region order). The event goes to `A3`
    // and its ancestors only if no region consumed it. Stops early if a region's transition left `A3`.
    private void a3_dispatch_regions(EventId event_id)
    {
        bool consumed = false;
        this.a3_exited = false;
        
        if (this.a3_region_1_dispatch(event_id))
        {
            consumed = true;
        }
        if (this.a3_exited)
        {
            return;
        }
        
        if (this.a3_region_2_dispatch(event_id))
        {
            consumed = true;
        }
        if (this.a3_exited)
        {
            return;
        }
        
        this.region_event_unhandled = false;
        if (consumed)
        {
            return;
        }
        
        // No region consumed the event: `A3` and its ancestors get it.
        switch (event_id)
        {
            case EventId.EV2: this.a3_ev2(); break;
            case EventId.EV8: this.a3_ev8(); break;
            default: this.region_event_unhandled = true; break;
        }
    }

            // Step 2: Transition action: `trace("PAR RESET");`.

    private void b3_ev5()
    {
        // note: no ancestor consumes this event, but we output `bool consume_event` anyway because a user's design might rely on it.
        bool consume_event = false;
        
        // B3 behavior
        // uml: EV5 TransitionTo(B2.<History>)
        {
            // Step 1: Exit states until we reach `<Ortho>(PAR_REGION_2)` state (Least Common Ancestor for transition).
            this.b3_exit();
            
            // Step 2: Transition action: ``.
            
            // Step 3: Enter/move towards transition target `B2.<History>`.
            this.b2_enter();
            // B2.<History> is a pseudo state and cannot have an `enter` trigger.
            
            // B2.<History> behavior
            // uml: [$gil(this.vars.B2_history == B2_HistoryId.B2B)] TransitionTo(B2b)
            if (____GilData_VarArgsToBool(this.vars.B2_history == B2_HistoryId.B2B))
            {
                // Step 1: Exit states until we reach `B2` state (Least Common Ancestor for transition). Already at LCA, no exiting required.
                
                // Step 2: Transition action: ``.
                
                // Step 3: Enter/move towards transition target `B2b`.
                this.b2b_enter();
                
                // Step 4: complete transition. Ends event dispatch. No other behaviors are checked.
                return;
            } // end of behavior for B2.<History>
            
            // B2.<History> behavior
            // uml: else TransitionTo(B2a)
            {
                // Step 1: Exit states until we reach `B2` state (Least Common Ancestor for transition). Already at LCA, no exiting required.
                
                // Step 2: Transition action: ``.
                
                // Step 3: Enter/move towards transition target `B2a`.
                this.b2a_enter();
                
                // Step 4: complete transition. Ends event dispatch. No other behaviors are checked.
                return;
            } // end of behavior for B2.<History>
        } // end of behavior for B3
        
        // Not consumed inside this region: tell the region dispatcher (the orthogonal parent may handle it).
        if (!consume_event)
        {
            this.region_event_unhandled = true;
        }
    }
    
    // Thread safe. This function can be disabled with `outputStateIdToStringFunction` setting.
    public static string state_id_to_string(StateId id)
    {
        switch (id)
        {
            case StateId.ROOT: return "ROOT";
            case StateId.IDLE: return "IDLE";
            case StateId.PAR: return "PAR";
            case StateId.PAR_REGION_1: return "PAR_REGION_1";
            case StateId.A1: return "A1";
            case StateId.A2: return "A2";
            case StateId.A3: return "A3";
            case StateId.A3_REGION_1: return "A3_REGION_1";
            case StateId.X1: return "X1";
            case StateId.X2: return "X2";
            case StateId.A3_REGION_2: return "A3_REGION_2";
            case StateId.Y1: return "Y1";
            case StateId.PAR_REGION_2: return "PAR_REGION_2";
            case StateId.B1: return "B1";
            case StateId.B2: return "B2";
            case StateId.B2A: return "B2A";
            case StateId.B2B: return "B2B";
            case StateId.B3: return "B3";
            default: return "?";
        }
    }
    
    // Thread safe. This function can be disabled with `outputEventIdToStringFunction` setting.
    public static string event_id_to_string(EventId id)
    {
        switch (id)
        {
            case EventId.DEEP: return "DEEP";
            case EventId.DO: return "DO";
            case EventId.EV1: return "EV1";
            case EventId.EV2: return "EV2";
            case EventId.EV3: return "EV3";
            case EventId.EV4: return "EV4";
            case EventId.EV5: return "EV5";
            case EventId.EV6: return "EV6";
            case EventId.EV7: return "EV7";
            case EventId.EV8: return "EV8";
            case EventId.GO: return "GO";
            case EventId.LEAVE: return "LEAVE";
            case EventId.LEAVE2: return "LEAVE2";
            case EventId.RESET: return "RESET";
            default: return "?";
        }
    }
    
    // Returns the parent state for a given state. Returns ROOT if input has no parent.
    // Thread safe. This function can be disabled with `outputGetParentIdFunction` setting.
    public static StateId get_parent_id(StateId id)
    {
        switch (id)
        {
            case StateId.ROOT: return StateId.ROOT;
            case StateId.IDLE: return StateId.ROOT;
            case StateId.PAR: return StateId.ROOT;
            case StateId.PAR_REGION_1: return StateId.PAR;
            case StateId.A1: return StateId.PAR_REGION_1;
            case StateId.A2: return StateId.PAR_REGION_1;
            case StateId.A3: return StateId.PAR_REGION_1;
            case StateId.A3_REGION_1: return StateId.A3;
            case StateId.X1: return StateId.A3_REGION_1;
            case StateId.X2: return StateId.A3_REGION_1;
            case StateId.A3_REGION_2: return StateId.A3;
            case StateId.Y1: return StateId.A3_REGION_2;
            case StateId.PAR_REGION_2: return StateId.PAR;
            case StateId.B1: return StateId.PAR_REGION_2;
            case StateId.B2: return StateId.PAR_REGION_2;
            case StateId.B2A: return StateId.B2;
            case StateId.B2B: return StateId.B2;
            case StateId.B3: return StateId.PAR_REGION_2;
            default: return StateId.ROOT;
        }
    }
    
    public static bool ____GilData_EchoStringBool(string toEcho) { return true; }
    public static void ____GilData_EchoStringVoid(string toEcho) { }
    public static bool ____GilData_VarArgsToBool(params object[] args) { return true; }
    public static void ____GilData_UnusedVar(object unusedVar) { }
}
